Evidence of discharge occurrence or absence for evaluated monitoring periods (e.g., flow reports or documented no-discharge periods)

grounding.excerpt: 1. FINAL Effluent Limits – Outfall 001 – Intermittent Flow ... pH ... 1/Week (*1) ... Flow ... 2/Week (*1) ... Total Suspended Solids ... 1/Week (*1) ... Total Residual Chlorine ... 1/Day (*1) ... Cyanide, Total Recoverable ... 1/Quarter (*1) ... Total Dissolved Solids ... 1/Quarter (*1) ... Footnotes: *1 When discharging.

payload.rationale: The packet provides permit text linking (*1)-marked monitoring frequencies for Outfall 001 (intermittent flow) to footnote *1 ('When discharging.'), which is conditional language but does not by itself establish how compliance evaluations apply across an entire evaluation year. The obligation also requires evidence of discharge occurrence or absence for evaluated monitoring periods during Federal FY2025; no flow reports, DMR data, or documented no-discharge periods appear in the packet. The packet itself flags that it may be evidence-insufficient. Without period-specific discharge evidence, neither ACCEPT (that (*1) requirements apply only during actual discharge for evaluated FY2025 periods) nor REJECT (that they apply regardless of discharge state) can be grounded. Preferring unsupported uncertainty to unsupported semantic closure, UNRESOLVED is the correct disposition.
